title: Operator Overloading: 2-D Vectors
hints: Operators are `static func`s; new operators need a declaration and precedence group.
Define `+`, prefix `-`, `*` in both orders, `+=` with `inout`, and `•` for the dot product.
`infix operator • : MultiplicationPrecedence` and `static func • (l: Vector2, r: Vector2) -> Double { l.x * r.x + l.y * r.y }`.
jsBridge: Operator overloading (`static func +`) lets vectors add naturally. JS can't overload operators at all (`valueOf` hacks aside). Custom operators like `•` need a declared precedence group.

compass.q: JS has no operator overloading. What libraries (gl-matrix) do instead? What's more readable?
